# Monitor UCEJ

> Monitor UCEJ provides real-time access monitoring, gate passes, and occupancy tracking for the UCEJ campus.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://monitor-ucej.in/): Main entry point and live access dashboard.
- [Scans](https://monitor-ucej.in/scans): Real-time gate scan logs and validations.
- [Occupancy](https://monitor-ucej.in/occupancy): Live campus occupancy and visitor analytics.
- [Help & Documentation](https://monitor-ucej.in/help): Guides, support, and documentation.

## Resources

- [API Endpoints](https://monitor-ucej.in/api): System APIs and status checks.
- [Contact Support](https://monitor-ucej.in/help): Help and administrator contact.
